title: Trial Lesson Calendar Entry - Surface Scope - Back Office Trial Lesson - Calendar Entry Not Added
description: AC 01.5 - Permission Matrix - Lesson Calendar entry point from Trial Lesson remains SF-only and is not introduced on BO Trial Lesson surface.
preconditions:
- Actor has access to Salesforce and Back Office as HQ or CM Staff.
- Trial Lesson TL-3001 exists and is visible in both systems where applicable.
steps_actions:
1. Open Trial Lesson TL-3001 detail in Salesforce.
2. Open corresponding Trial Lesson detail in Back Office.
3. Inspect BO action area for Trial Lesson calendar entry.
steps_result:
1. Lesson Calendar button is visible in SF Trial Lesson detail.
2. Trial Lesson detail opens in BO surface.
3. No new Trial Lesson Lesson Calendar entry point is shown in BO.
steps_data:
1. sf_trial_lesson = TL-3001
2. bo_trial_lesson = TL-3001
3. expected_bo_entry = absent

title: Trial Lesson Calendar Entry - Missing Student Edge - Trial Lesson Student Unavailable - Deterministic Handling Displayed
description: AC 01.3 edge - Negative - When Trial Lesson student becomes unavailable, navigation behavior is deterministic and does not create wrong student context.
preconditions:
- Actor is logged in to Salesforce as HQ or CM Staff.
- Trial Lesson TL-3002 exists but linked student STU-099 is inactive or inaccessible.
- TL-3002 detail page is open.
steps_actions:
1. Click Lesson Calendar button on Trial Lesson TL-3002 detail.
2. Open student selection/filter panel in calendar.
3. Observe system feedback area after load.
steps_result:
1. Lesson Calendar navigation completes without crash.
2. STU-099 is not incorrectly selected as an active context student.
3. System shows deterministic fallback behavior/message per implementation and does not assign a wrong student context implicitly.
steps_data:
1. trial_lesson = TL-3002
2. unavailable_student = STU-099
3. expected_behavior = explicit_fallback
